# Conscious
AI platform for self-awareness. Prototype: mood scoring of journal entries. Run: python app.py < entries.txt (sample included)

Features: negation-aware scoring, trend detection, average. Roadmap: LLM reflections, privacy-first local storage.

Note: scores are a simple lexicon heuristic, not clinical. Use as a reflection aid only. Themes ignore synonyms for now (next: stemming/embeddings).
